name: deploy-cloudflare
description: GitHub Actions that test, apply D1 migrations and deploy the Worker API (and optionally a static web app) to staging on every push to main and to production on a release.

API_DIR.help: directory with the Worker's wrangler.jsonc, relative to the repo root

WEB_DIR.help: directory of a Vite web app to deploy with Workers static assets; empty to skip

next: Add "env": { "staging": {...}, "production": {...} } to {{API_DIR}}/wrangler.jsonc with one D1 database per environment (see the deploy-cloudflare skill).
Create the databases: wrangler d1 create <name>-staging and wrangler d1 create <name>-production; paste their ids into the env sections.
Set repository secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (gh secret set NAME).
Create GitHub environments 'staging' and 'production'; add required reviewers to production.
Set each Worker secret per environment: wrangler secret put NAME --env staging (and --env production).
